newsitem.title: USA: Clinton gives honorary citizenship to Mother Teresa.
newsitem.headline: Clinton gives honorary citizenship to Mother Teresa.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Tuesday signed a bill bestowing honorary U.S. citizenship on Mother Teresa, the 86-year-old nun who has devoted her life to helping the destitute and dying.
"She has brought hope and love into the lives of millions of orphaned and abandoned children the world over," Clinton said in a statement.
"She has nursed the sick, cared for the poor and shown us through concrete actions how we can make real our dreams for a just and good society," he said.

Mother Teresa, who was awarded the 1979 Nobel Peace Prize, founded a Roman Catholic missionary order in 1950 which now ministers to the needy, dying and orphaned in the slums of 200 cities around the world.
